surface.$description: Flat surfaces on the page, such as cards and panels. The same white as raised, without the shadow.

raised.$description: Surfaces that float above the page: popovers, menus, the prompt bar. Pair with shadow-raised.

sunken.$description: Wells set into a surface, such as a code block.

hover.$description: Fill behind a transparent row or control under the pointer.

active.$description: Fill behind a transparent row or control while pressed or selected.

primary.$description: Default text and icons: labels, typed input.

secondary.$description: Supporting text and icons: descriptions, hints, toolbar icons. At least 4.5:1 on every background fill.

diverges.reason: The sampled grey #767587 measured 4.21:1 on bg-page and 3.99:1 on bg-hover, below 4.5:1 for text.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls.

contrast.exempt: Disabled controls are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on dark fills.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent-solid. White measures only 2.66:1 there.

separator.$description: Lines that divide content, such as the rule above a hint.

subtle.$description: Hairline edge of raised surfaces. The ring inside shadow-raised uses the same colour.

default.$description: Borders that enclose a control where the border is decoration, not its only edge.

contrast.exempt: Decoration: the control keeps another visible edge. Use border-strong when the border is the only one.

strong.$description: Borders that are the only visible edge of a control. At least 3:1 on page, surface and raised.

focus.$description: Focus indicators. At least 3:1 on page, surface and raised.

solid.$description: The one filled primary action in a view, such as send.

contrast.exempt: The glyph identifies the control, and text-on-accent carries its contrast on the fill.
The glyph identifies the control, and text-on-accent carries its contrast on the fill.

solid-hover.$description: accent-solid under the pointer. text-on-accent stays at least 4.5:1 on it.

subtle.$description: Tinted background for selected or highlighted items.

text.$description: Accent text and icons, such as links. At least 4.5:1 on page, surface, raised and accent-subtle.

base.$description: The UI typeface. Load Figtree in the app; without it, text falls back to system-ui.

md.$description: Labels and item titles. 14px on a 16px line box.

sm.$description: Compact control labels, such as a model picker. 12px on a 16px line box.

md.$description: Descriptions and body text. 14px on a 16px line box.

sm.$description: Hints and helper text. 12px on a 16px line box.

md.$description: Typed input text. 14px on a 28px line box, the height of size-control-sm.

xs.$description: Tight gap between a label and its glyph, such as a chevron.

sm.$description: Default gap between items in a row or a stack.
Padding inside surfaces and around lists.

lg.$description: Padding for text set directly against a surface edge, such as a hint.

sm.$description: Small glyphs beside text, such as a chevron.

lg.$description: Large input containers, such as the prompt bar.

pill.$description: Pills: controls and bars with fully round ends, such as the prompt bar. Only the sharp radius scale squares them off.

circle.$description: Circles: square controls and avatars, such as icon buttons. Round on every radius scale.

raised.$description: Elevation for raised surfaces: the Figma effect style shadow. Six soft layers and a 1px ring, in CSS paint order.

fast.$description: Small elements, such as a tooltip appearing.

normal.$description: The default, such as a dropdown opening.

moderate.$description: Medium elements, such as a dialog entering. UI motion stays under 300ms.

standard.$description: Elements changing state or moving within the view.

enter.$description: Elements entering the view. Never an ease-in.

hover.$description: Colour changes under the pointer. Gate it behind (hover: hover).

focus.$description: Focus rings appear at once: keyboard-driven changes get no motion.

base.$description: Opacity and transform changes within the view.

duration.$description: How long an element takes to arrive.

travel.$description: How far an element travels as it arrives. None under reduced motion.

scale.$description: The scale an element grows from as it arrives, never from 0.

duration.$description: How long an element takes to leave. Shorter than arriving.

travel.$description: How far an element travels as it leaves. None under reduced motion.

scale.$description: The scale an element shrinks to as it leaves.

duration.$description: How long a control takes to press in. Slower than release.

scale.$description: The scale a pressed control shrinks to.

duration.$description: How long a pressed control takes to spring back.

step.$description: Delay between related elements entering together. A sequence stays under 500ms.

cadence.$description: Interval between streamed text chunks. Phase 5 sets the streaming feel.

pulse.$description: One cycle of the thinking pulse. Loops keep running under reduced motion.

shimmer.$description: One cycle of the loading shimmer.
